title: LinkedIn Post Comments
description: Returns the comments LinkedIn shows on the logged-out view of a public post: commenter name, comment text, timestamp and reaction count. No account, cookie or login is involved. Read-only by design: the public view carries no comment URNs, so these comments identify who said what but cannot be used to address a reply. It also omits nested replies and truncates long threads.

postIds.description: Post URLs, activity ids, or urn:li:activity urns.

maxItems.description: Cap on comments returned per post.

scrapeReplies.description: Accepted for compatibility. The logged-out view exposes no nested replies, so this changes nothing and is reported in the run summary.
